consequence.statement: After upgrading, a status condition is now written on AuthorizationPolicy resources bound to a waypoint proxy; the formatting of these conditions is experimental and will change, and a policy with multiple targetRefs presently receives a single condition rather than one per reference.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is required; do not rely on the condition formatting (it is experimental and will change) and expect only a single condition for policies with multiple targetRefs until Istio adopts the upstream Kubernetes Gateway API convention.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds writing a status condition on AuthorizationPolicy resources bound to a waypoint proxy; the condition formatting is experimental and will change, and policies with multiple targetRefs presently receive a single condition until Istio adopts an upstream Kubernetes Gateway API convention for multiple references.
